name: Floor rail, galvanised steel channel
function: Carries one side of the machine. The wheels run in its channel.

name: Rail end buffer, polyurethane
function: Takes the blow of a wheel at the end stop.

name: Rail anchor plate 260 x 160 x 12
function: Spreads the rail load into the slab. Grouted under.

name: Rail end stop block
function: Stops a wheel at the rail end if the machine runs past its travel.

name: Socket head cap screw M10 x 60
function: Holds the end stop through the rail floor to its anchor plate.

name: Concrete screw anchor M12 x 100
function: Holds the anchor plate in the slab. No mortar: it cuts its own thread.

name: Axle end block
function: Holds the idler wheel axle in the trolley wall.

name: Trolley weldment
material: Structural steel S355, painted safety yellow
function: Carries one leg on 2 wheels and the travel drive.

name: Wheel axle, 50 mm
function: Carries the wheel bearing between the trolley walls. The gearmotor drives it on the driven wheel.

name: Side guide roller 60 mm
function: Keeps the wheel centred in its rail.

name: Travel gearmotor 0.75 kW, helical-bevel, brake, encoder
function: Drives one wheel. The brake holds the machine still while it sprays.

name: Travel wheel 200 x 60, polyurethane on steel hub
function: Rolls in the rail channel. Quiet on wet steel.

name: Deep groove ball bearing 6210-2RS
function: Carries the wheel on its axle.

name: Hex head screw M10 x 35
function: Holds the travel gearmotor flange to the trolley.

name: Hex head screw M12 x 50
function: Holds the axle end block to the trolley wall.

name: Plain washer 10
subsystems: Travel drive x8; Air knives (dryer) x24
function: Puts the clamp force of the head or the nut on a larger area, so the part surface does not crush and the preload stays constant.

name: Plain washer 12
function: Puts the clamp force of the head or the nut on a larger area, so the part surface does not crush and the preload stays constant.

name: Portal beam weldment
material: Structural steel S355, painted safety yellow
function: Spans the bay: 2 chords and 4 cross members, closed by a deck top and bottom into a box girder. Every tool hangs below it at its own station, so none can meet another; the drives stand on top.

name: Beam bottom deck, aluminium checker plate 4 mm
function: Closes the beam between its chords and carries the tools hung below it and the drives on it.

name: Beam top deck, aluminium checker plate 4 mm
function: Closes the beam between its chords and carries the tools hung below it and the drives on it.

name: Leg cladding panel, aluminium 2 mm
function: Covers the leg frame. It keeps spray out of the frame.

name: Portal leg weldment
material: Structural steel S355, painted safety yellow
function: Carries the beam over the trolley: 2 posts and 2 braces. Its flanges bolt top and bottom.

name: Hex head screw M16 x 60
function: Bolts the leg flange to the trolley or the beam. The lock nut holds under vibration.

name: Prevailing-torque hex nut (nylon insert) M16
function: Holds the bolt's clamp force on the far side of the joint. The nylon ring grips the thread, so vibration cannot turn the nut loose.

name: Plain washer 16
function: Puts the clamp force of the head or the nut on a larger area, so the part surface does not crush and the preload stays constant.

name: Button head screw M6 x 16
function: Holds the cladding panel to the leg post.

name: Arch bracket, stainless
function: Ties the arch pipe to the leg post.

name: Arch hanger strap, stainless
function: Hangs the arch top pipe from the bottom deck.

name: Pipe saddle clamp, stainless
function: Holds the arch pipe to its bracket.

name: Flat-fan spray nozzle 1/4 in, 15 deg
subsystems: Spray arch x23; Sensor-wipe arms x2
function: Makes a 15 degree flat fan. Its tip is the only part that wears.

name: Arch feed hose, 1 in, stainless braid
function: Brings the switched liquid from the manifold to the arch.

name: Spray arch manifold, 124 mm
function: Carries the pre-soak, the wash water and the rinse water to the nozzles. Stainless: wash chemicals do not touch carbon steel.

name: Valve manifold, stainless, 4 stations
function: Carries foam, rinse water and the 2 chemicals to the valves.

name: Solenoid valve G 1/2, 24 V DC, stainless
function: Switches one chemical or the rinse water to the arch.

name: Air knife bracket, stainless
function: Hangs an air knife from its slide.

name: Lift column clamp plate, stainless
function: Holds a lift column sleeve under the bottom deck.

name: Lift column foot plate
function: Closes the column foot and bolts to the knife bracket.

name: Top air knife lift column sleeve, 140 x 140 x 5
function: Fixed through the beam. It guides the column's first stage.

name: Top air knife lift column stage 2, 122 x 122
function: Slides a third of the travel. A belt over its pulley drives the next stage.

name: Top air knife lift column stage 3, 106 x 106
function: Slides a third of the travel. A belt over its pulley drives the next stage.

name: Top air knife lift column stage 4, 90 x 90
function: Slides a third of the travel and carries the tool at its foot.

name: Centrifugal blower 4 kW, wash-down
function: Makes the drying air. The air leaves the knives at high speed.

name: Top knife lift servo gearmotor 0.4 kW, brake
function: Drives its column by a toothed belt. Its brake holds the knife with power off.

name: Top air knife lift column slide pad, UHMW-PE
function: Guides a stage in the one outside it. No grease to wash off.

name: Flexible duct, 170 mm, PU with wire helix
function: Feeds a side knife from its blower. Its loop swings in as the knife closes on the car.

name: Flexible duct, 170 mm, PU with wire helix
function: Feeds a side knife from its blower. Its loop swings in as the knife closes on the car.

name: Concertina duct, 380 x 160, coated fabric on a steel coil frame
function: Feeds the top knife from its blower. It folds as the knife goes up and stretches as it goes down.

name: Duct collar 160 mm, stainless
function: Takes the flexible duct's end. A hose clamp holds the duct on it.

name: Side air knife, stainless
function: Blows the water off one flank.

name: Top air knife, stainless
function: Blows a sheet of air down over the car top. It follows the shape.

name: Hex head screw M10 x 40
function: Holds the blower foot to the beam frame, on a rubber mount.

name: Socket head cap screw M8 x 20
function: Holds the lift column clamp plate to the bottom deck.

name: Prevailing-torque hex nut (nylon insert) M10
function: Holds the bolt's clamp force on the far side of the joint. The nylon ring grips the thread, so vibration cannot turn the nut loose.

name: Wipe arm carriage
function: Runs on 2 rails under the beam and carries one wipe arm across the bay.

name: Wrist forearm with hinge fork, stainless
function: Carries the pad out from the mast, so the mast stays clear of the car while the pad is on it.

name: Mast foot plate, stainless
function: Closes the mast's last stage and carries the wrist.

name: Pad hinge hub, stainless
function: Turns in the forearm's fork and carries the pad head.

name: Cable chain end bracket, stainless
function: Holds the chain's fixed end under the deck.

name: Cable chain carrier bracket, stainless
function: Joins the chain's moving end to the carriage.

name: Wipe arm mast sleeve, 110 x 110 x 5, with flange
function: Hangs from the carriage. It guides the mast's first stage.

name: Wipe arm mast stage 2, 92 x 92
function: Slides half the drop. A belt over its pulley drives the next stage.

name: Wipe arm mast stage 3, 76 x 76
function: Slides half the drop and carries the wrist at its foot.

name: Profile rail block size 25
function: Recirculating ball carriage. It runs on the rail and carries the moving stage.

name: Profile rail size 25 x 2100
function: Hardened guide rail. It carries the block in a straight line with no play.

name: Carriage gearmotor 0.37 kW, brake, encoder, right-angle
function: Moves the wipe arm across the bay.

name: Pinion module 2, 20 teeth, stainless
function: Drives the wipe arm carriage along its rack.

name: Mast servo gearmotor 0.2 kW, brake, absolute encoder
function: Raises and lowers the mast by a belt inside it. Its brake holds the mast when power is off.

name: Gear rack module 2, 20 x 20, stainless
function: The carriage pinion runs along it.

name: Wrist tilt actuator, 12 Nm, IP67
function: Swings the pad from face-down, stowed, to face-on to the car.

name: Wrist turn actuator, hollow shaft, 30 Nm, IP67
function: Turns the forearm about the mast's axis, so the pad faces the flank, the nose or the tail.

name: Wipe arm mast slide pad, UHMW-PE
function: Guides a mast stage in the one outside it. No grease to wash off.

name: Sensor-finding camera with ring light, IP67
function: Finds each camera, lidar and radar cover on the car, so the pad goes to the sensor and not to the paint.

name: Force sensor, 50 N, IP67
function: Measures the pad's push on the car. The arm stops its push at the set limit.

name: Cable carrier link 38 x 25
function: Guides the cables and hoses through the moving joint. It keeps the bend radius safe.

name: Cable gland block, stainless
function: Takes the wrist's line out of the sleeve's side at its foot.

name: Wrist line: 2 motor cables, camera, sensor, 6 mm water, in a PUR jacket
function: Feeds the wrist, the camera and the pad's water nozzle as the mast goes down.

name: Wrist line: 2 motor cables, camera, sensor, 6 mm water, in a PUR jacket
function: Feeds the wrist, the camera and the pad's water nozzle as the mast goes down.

name: Wipe pad, microfibre on foam, hook-and-loop
function: The only part that touches the car. It wipes a sensor cover as a soft cloth in a hand does.

name: Pad plate on springs, 6 mm travel
function: Lets the pad give 6 mm, so it follows a curved cover with an even, light push.

name: Hex head screw M8 x 25
function: Holds the mast sleeve's flange under the carriage floor.

name: Socket head cap screw M6 x 16
subsystems: Control, supply and signals x4; Sensor-wipe arms x24
function: Holds the mast gearmotor to the sleeve.

name: Socket head cap screw M6 x 20
function: Holds the wipe arm rail to the bottom deck.

name: Cabinet wall lug, stainless
function: Hangs the control cabinet on the leg.

name: Trench cover, slotted, galvanised checker plate
function: Covers the trench flush with the floor. The driver runs in its slot.

name: Drag chain trench liner, galvanised
function: Lines the trench the drag chain runs in, inboard of the west rail, under the cover.

name: Trench tie strap, galvanised flat 40 x 3
function: Ties the trench liner to the rail anchor plates, so the two stay in line.

name: Drag chain carrier arm, stainless
function: Joins the driver to the trolley's inner wall. The lines run through it to the conduit.

name: Drag chain driver duct, stainless
function: Pushes and pulls the chain's moving end through the cover's slot. The lines rise inside it.

name: Drag chain end bracket, stainless
function: Joins the chain's last link to the driver.

name: Stop light bracket, stainless
function: Hangs the stop light from the beam face.

name: Cable carrier link 120 x 50
function: Guides the cables and hoses through the moving joint. It keeps the bend radius safe.

name: Status beacon
function: Teal at home, green working, amber moving.

name: Control cabinet, stainless, IP66
function: Holds the controller, 8 drives, the safety relay and the valve outputs. It talks to the twin over the site network.

name: Cable conduit, chain to cabinet, 60 mm
function: Carries the chain's lines from the arm up the leg to the control cabinet.

name: Signal lamp, green, 100 mm
function: Green: the machine is home. The car may go.

name: Signal lamp, red, 100 mm
function: Red: the program runs. The car must not move.

name: Stop light housing
function: Faces the arriving car. It tells the car and its driver to stop or go.

name: Slot brush strip, nylon on aluminium back
function: Closes the cover's slot round the driver against grit and spray.

name: Hex head screw M10 x 30
function: Holds the cabinet lug to the leg post.
